title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chandayatha's parents call to announce their visit for her pregnancy celebration. Cheran's family panics, unsure how to face them when Chandayatha is not pregnant.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Bagyaraj considers calling Malar but hesitates, remembering their conflict. Ragavan criticises Mathi's simple meal, and she admits she cannot match Malar's cooking.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Aishwarya warns Eshwari that she will be held accountable if involved in Sethupathi's allegations. Abhinav announces money for eye surgeries for each victim to gain public support.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: After seeing Kasthuri wash clothes, Karthik angrily questions Kamala for making her work. Angered by Kamala's complaint, Karikalan slaps Karthik for humiliating her.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Shanmugam tries hard to meet and speak with Abhi at her house, but she remains unwilling to talk to him. Kandhasamy grows furious upon seeing Indhira working as a delivery agent.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Senthil is upset by Meena's suggestion to postpone having a child until they are financially stable. Meanwhile, Kumar confronts Sudar over Muthuvel's support for her.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Rohini fears the troubles predicted in her horoscope after Lakshmi shares the warning. Muthu and Meena visit Seetha, where Arun makes up a story about his leg injury.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: At the divorce hearing, the judge counsels Vetri, Abinaya and Sudar separately. Considering Sudar's future, the judge orders them to live together with Sudar for six months.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: As the doctor advises Poongodi to complete her glucose drip, Azhagar looks after her in the hospital. Later, Mayandi feels happy to see his growing concern for Poongodi.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Viji explains to Paraman the pain a woman endures when blamed for not conceiving. Paraman brings an astrologer, who declares tonight auspicious for his wedding night with Ilamathi.
